blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Improving robot policies on new tasks without collecting
additional expert demonstrations remains a central challenge
in robot learning.
World action models (WAMs) use broad video priors to jointly
predict future videos and actions, offering a potential source of supervision for adapting to new tasks.
However, generated videos may fail to depict task completion, and even visually successful videos may be paired with inconsistent actions that lead to execution failure.
We propose EVO-WAM , a framework that adapts WAMs to unseen tasks by learning from their own generated video-action trajectories, without executing candidate actions in an external environment.
First, we augment WAM training with state prediction and
anchored multi-frame context to enable complete autoregressive
rollouts without external execution feedback.
Second, we identify reliable training experience by selecting
task-completing prefixes with a vision-language model and
verifying their video-action consistency with an inverse
dynamics model.
Third, we iteratively train the WAM on verified prefixes and
generate new rollouts with the updated model.
On seven unseen RoboTwin 2.0 tasks, EVO-WAM
increases average success rates from
26.9% to 68.0% for Cosmos3 and from
28.5% to 46.4% for DreamZero,
reaching approximately 2.5 × 2.5\times and 1.6 × 1.6\times their
initial success rates.
On three unseen long-horizon composite tasks in the real world,
it improves Cosmos3’s average success rate
from 20.0% to 76.7%, a gain of
56.7 percentage points. Project Page: https://evo-wam.github.io/ .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Adapting robot policies to unseen tasks without collecting additional expert demonstrations remains a central challenge in robot learning. Large-scale robot datasets [ Khazatsky et al., 2024 , Jiang et al., 2025 , Hou et al., 2025 , Wu et al., 2025 ] have enabled increasingly general policies, but extending demonstration coverage to new tasks remains costly [ Yang et al., 2026b ] .
blocks.zh: 使机器人政策适应无形的任务而不收集更多的专家演示,仍然是机器人学习的一个中心挑战。 大型机器人数据集[Khazatsky等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2025年;Hou等人,2025年;Wu等人,2025年]使得政策越来越普遍,但将示范范围扩大到新的任务仍然代价高昂[Yang等人,2026b].

blocks.en: To support such generalization, world action models (WAMs) [ Bi et al., 2025 , Zhang et al., 2026 , Chen et al., 2026 , Wu et al., 2026b ] draw on broad video priors to jointly predict future videos and actions. Acquired through large-scale video pretraining [ NVIDIA, 2026 , Team Wan et al., 2025 ] , these priors capture motion, physical interactions, and scene evolution, allowing video predictions to guide action generation and planning [ Zhen et al., 2025 , Ko et al., 2023 , Yuan et al., 2026a ] . Recent models, including DreamZero [ Ye et al., 2026 ] , Cosmos3, and LingBot-VA [ Li et al., 2026 ] , can complete unseen tasks or make progress toward their goals in some trials, suggesting that video priors offer useful knowledge beyond the tasks covered by robot demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 为了支持这种概括,世界行动模式[ Bi等人,2025年,张某1等人,2026年,陈某1等人,2026年,吴某1等人,2026年b)]利用宽宽视频前传,共同预测未来视频与行动. 通过大规模视频预训[NVIDIA,2026年,Team Wan等人,2025年]获得这些前传捕捉运动,物理互动,场景演化,使得视频预测能够指导动作生成和规划[Zhen等人,2025年,Ko等人,2023年,袁等人,2026年a]. 包括DreamZero [Ye et al., 2026], Cosmos3, 和LingBot-VA [Li et al., 2026] 在内的近期模型,可以完成一些隐形的任务,或者在一些试验中朝着目标取得进展,说明视频前传提供了超出机器人演示所覆盖的任务的有用知识.

blocks.en:
However, this potential does not guarantee successful adaptation
to unseen tasks. Specifically, as illustrated in
Figure 6 , existing WAMs do not consistently generate videos depicting task completion.
Even under the same initial conditions, generated videos may
depict either success or failure. Moreover, the paired actions
may be inconsistent with the visually depicted behavior,
leading to execution failure even when the video depicts
success. This raises a question: Can a WAM improve its performance on unseen tasks by identifying and learning from reliable trajectories within its own generated rollouts?
blocks.zh:
然而,这种潜力并不能保证成功的适应
用于隐藏任务。 具体地说,如
图6 现有WAM不连贯地生成描述任务完成情况的视频.
即使在相同的初始条件下,生成的视频也可能
描述成败。 此外,配对行动
可能与视觉描绘的行为不符,
导致执行失败 即使视频描绘
成功吗? 这提出了一个问题: 一个WAM能否通过在自己产生的推出过程中确定和学习可靠的轨迹来改进其在无形任务上的绩效?

blocks.en: Existing methods have used separate world models to generate experience for policy improvement [ Guo et al., 2026 , Zhu et al., 2025 , Guo et al., 2025b , Jang et al., 2025 , Qiu et al., 2026a , Kim et al., 2026b ] . WAM-generated replay has also been used to preserve previously learned skills during continual learning [ Govind et al., 2026 ] . However, these approaches still rely on experience from a separate world model or task demonstrations to learn new tasks, leaving the WAM’s own video priors unexploited as a source of supervision for unseen-task improvement.
blocks.zh: 现有方法使用单独的世界模型来产生改进政策的经验[Guo等人,2026年;Zhu等人,2025年;Guo等人,2025年b;Jang等人,2025年;Quu等人,2026年a;Kim等人,2026年b]。 WAM生成的重播也被用于在持续学习期间保存以前学到的技能[Govind等人,2026年]。 然而,这些方法仍然依靠单独的世界模式或任务演示的经验来学习新的任务,使得WAM自己的视频前身没有被开发出来作为监督的源头,用于改进无形的任务。

blocks.en:
Our key observation is that a WAM can improve on unseen tasks by learning from its own generated rollouts that depict successful task completion and preserve video-action consistency, without executing actions in an external environment. However, obtaining such rollouts raises two
challenges. First, the model must generate complete rollouts without receiving updated observations or robot states from an external environment. Second, it requires actions that are consistent with the generated video and can faithfully realize the depicted behavior during execution.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要观察是,一个WAM可以通过学习它自己产生的展示任务成功完成和保持视频行动一致性的推广,而不是在外部环境中执行行动,来改进看不见的任务。 但是,获得这种推广,需要两项措施。
挑战。 首先,模型必须生成完整的推出,而无需从外部环境中收到更新的观测结果或机器人状态. 第二,它需要与生成的视频一致的行动,并且能够忠实地实现被描绘的处决期间的行为.

blocks.en:
Motivated by this observation, we present EVO-WAM , a framework for improving world action models through video-action verification, as shown in Fig. 1 and 2 . We augment WAM training with state prediction and anchored multi-frame context, enabling complete autoregressive continuation without external execution feedback. To identify reliable
rollouts, we use a vision-language model (VLM) to select task-completing prefixes and an
inverse dynamics model (IDM) [ Tian et al., 2025 ] to verify their video-action consistency. We train the WAM on prefixes that pass both stages
and use the updated model to generate new candidates, iteratively
improving performance on unseen tasks.
blocks.zh:
基于这一观察,我们提出EVO-WAM,通过视频行动核查改进世界行动模式的框架,见图1和图2。 我们通过国家预测和定位的多框架背景,加强WAM培训,以便能够在没有外部执行反馈的情况下完全自动地继续。 确定可靠的
推出后,我们使用视觉语言模型(VLM)来选择任务完成前缀和一个
反向动态模型(IDM)[Tian等人,2025年]验证其视频动作一致性. 我们训练WAM 前缀,通过两个阶段
并使用更新的模型,迭代生成新候选人
改善在无形任务上的绩效。

blocks.en:
We evaluate EVO-WAM across two WAM backbones, Cosmos3 [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] and DreamZero [ Ye et al., 2026 ] , on seven RoboTwin 2.0 [ Chen et al., 2025 ] tasks unseen during base-model training, where self-training on verified trajectories increases average success rates from 26.9% to 68.0% and from 28.5% to 46.4%, respectively. We further evaluate EVO-WAM Cosmos3 on three unseen long-horizon composite tasks in the real world, improving average success from 20.0% to 76.7%. Additionally, our study in Section 4.5 shows that verifying both task completion and video-action consistency is important for substantial gains from self-training.
This verification process is effective with both the large, highly capable Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [ Qiu et al., 2026b ] and the smaller, efficient Qwen3.5-27B [ Qwen Team, 2026 ] . Our seen-task evaluation further shows that EVO-WAM Cosmos3 largely preserves performance on seen tasks.
blocks.zh:
我们评价EVO-WAM跨越两个WAM主干网,Cosmos3 [NVIDIA, 2026] 和DreamZero [Ye等人, 2026],在基建培训期间未见的7项RoboTwin 2.0 [Chen等人, 2025]任务上,经过核实的轨迹自学将平均成功率分别从26.9%提高到68.0%和从28.5%提高到46.4%。 我们进一步评价EVO-WAM Cosmos3在现实世界中三项看不见的长视距综合任务,将平均成功率从20.0%提高到76.7%。 此外,我们在第4.5节的研究表明,核查任务完成情况和视频行动的一致性,对于从自我培训中获得重大收益十分重要。
这种核查过程既与大型,高功率的Quen3.8-Flash-Next[邱等人,2026b],又与规模较小,效率高的Quen3.5-27B[Quen Team,2026]有效. 我们的任务评价进一步表明,EVO-WAM Cosmos3在很大程度上保持了所看到的任务的性能.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: • A framework for improving WAMs with generated experience. We introduce EVO-WAM, which enables WAMs to generate autoregressive video-action rollouts and improve on unseen tasks through verification and iterative self-training, without additional expert demonstrations or action execution in an external environment during self-evolution. • Verification of task completion and video-action consistency. We introduce a two-stage verification process in which a VLM identifies task-completing prefixes and an IDM assesses their video-action consistency, selecting generated rollouts for iterative self-training. • Generality across WAM backbones, tasks and VLMs. We demonstrate improvements across Cosmos3 and DreamZero on unseen RoboTwin tasks and with Cosmos3 on real-world long-horizon composite tasks. It also shows robustness to VLM choice, sustaining performance gains with verifiers of different sizes.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的贡献有三: 改进具有丰富经验的机制的框架。 我们引入了EVO-WAM,它使WAM能够通过核查和迭代自我训练,产生自发的视频动作推开,并改进无形的任务,在自我进化期间,在外部环境中没有额外的专家演示或行动执行. • 核查任务完成情况和视频行动的一致性。 我们引入了两阶段核查程序,其中VLM确定任务完成前缀,IDM评估其视频动作一致性,选择生成的展开进行迭代自我训练. · 纵横各式各样的WAM主干线、任务和VLM。 我们在“宇宙3”和“DreamZero”两个领域对“无人机”任务作了改进,在“宇宙3”领域对“现实世界长视距”复合任务作了改进。 它还显示出对VLM选择的稳健性,用不同大小的核查器维持性能增益.

blocks.en: 2.2 Self-Training with Generated Rollouts
blocks.zh: 2.2 自行培训

blocks.en:
In closed-loop control, WAMs such as DreamZero refresh their visual
context with observations after action execution [ Ye et al., 2026 , Li et al., 2026 ] .
Generating complete rollouts without this feedback requires predicted visual context
and robot states to condition subsequent chunks.
blocks.zh:
在闭路控制中,DreamZero等WAM刷新视觉
[Ye等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年]。
在没有这种反馈的情况下产生完整的推出需要预测的视觉上下文
和机器人状态 以条件后续块。

blocks.en:
Moreover, even when such trajectories can be generated, they do not necessarily provide
reliable supervision. First, videos sampled from the same initial conditions and task
instruction may depict either task success or failure, so task completion cannot be
assumed from generation alone. Second, even when a video depicts success, its paired actions may be inconsistent
with the depicted behavior and fail to realize it during execution [ Govind et al., 2026 ] . Training on rollouts
with either limitation may reinforce incomplete behaviors or actions that do not
achieve the imagined outcome. These limitations motivate assessing both visual task completion and video-action
consistency before using generated rollouts for self-training.
blocks.zh:
此外,即使可以产生这种轨迹,它们不一定提供
可靠的监督。 首先,从相同的初始条件和任务取样的视频
指令可以描述任务的成败,因此任务完成不能是
假设从一代人单独。 第二,即使一个视频描绘成功,它的配对动作也可能不一致
与被描绘的行为并在处决期间未能实现[Govind等人,2026年]. 关于推出的培训
限制可能强化不完全的行为或行动
实现想象中的结果。 这些限制促使评估视觉任务完成情况和视频行动
在使用生成的推广材料进行自我培训之前保持一致。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We present EVO-WAM, a framework for improving WAMs on unseen tasks through
video-action verification, as shown in Fig. 2 . For each scene of an unseen task, we are
given an initial observation o 0 o_{0} , a robot state s 0 s_{0} , and a task instruction ℓ \ell .
Our goal is to improve task performance without additional expert demonstrations or action
execution in an external environment. We enable autoregressive rollouts through state
prediction and context augmentation (Sec. 3.1 ), and select
reliable prefixes through video-action verification (Sec. 3.2 ).
Starting from a base model WAM 0 \mathrm{WAM}_{0} , we repeat generation, verification, and training
over multiple rounds, updating WAM r − 1 \mathrm{WAM}_{r-1} to WAM r \mathrm{WAM}_{r} using verified data
at each round r r (Sec. 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 3.1 Enabling Autoregressive Rollouts
blocks.zh: 3.1 自动推出

blocks.en:
Autoregressive continuation requires the robot state and visual context for the next chunk.
We therefore train the WAM to predict the robot state at the end of each chunk, providing the robot
configuration needed for continuation. For visual conditioning, we initialize the rollout
with a single frame and retain it as an anchor alongside recent generated frames during
continuation. The recent frames provide motion history, while the anchor remains a
persistent reference for the objects and scene.
blocks.zh:
自动递归续作需要下一个块的机器人状态和视觉上下文.
因此,我们训练WAM 预测机器人状态在每个块末端,提供机器人

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented EVO-WAM, a framework that enables world action models to improve on tasks unseen during base-model training by learning from their own generated experience. By enabling autoregressive rollouts and verifying task completion and video-action consistency, the framework turns model predictions into self-training data without additional expert demonstrations or external action execution during self-training. Evaluations with Cosmos3 and DreamZero on RoboTwin 2.0 demonstrate improvements across both WAM backbones, while real-world evaluations with Cosmos3 show gains on long-horizon composite tasks. These findings point to a path toward self-improving robot policies, where video-action verification enables WAMs to transform their own predictions into experience for adapting to new tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了EVO-WAM,这是一个框架,它使世界行动模式能够通过学习其自身产生的经验来改进基础模型培训中未见的任务。 该框架通过自动推出并核查任务完成情况和视频行动一致性,将模型预测转化为自我培训数据,而无需在自我培训期间进行额外的专家演示或外部行动执行。 与Cosmos3和DreamZero在RoboTwin 2.0上进行的评价显示,WAM两个骨干都有所改善,而与Cosmos3进行的实际世界评价显示,在长期综合任务方面有所进展。 这些结论指出了一条自我改进机器人政策的道路,通过视频行动核查,WAM能够将自己的预测转化为适应新任务的经验.

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关工作

blocks.en:
Reasoning models use feedback to learn beyond expert demonstrations. STaR iteratively trains on model-generated rationales that lead to correct answers [ Zelikman et al., 2022 ] . DeepSeek-R1 [ Guo et al., 2025a ] develops reasoning through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Absolute Zero [ Zhao et al., 2025 ] generates and solves executable tasks, using a code executor to validate them, while SEAL [ Zweiger et al., 2025 ] generates fine-tuning data and update directives and evaluates the resulting adaptation.
These approaches highlight the role of verification in learning from generated material. For embodied trajectories, verification must account for both task completion and consistency between visual outcomes and actions.
blocks.zh:
理性模型使用反馈来学习超越专家演示. STaR迭代列车在模型生成的原理上,导致正确答案[Zelikman等人,2022]. DeepSeek-R1 [Guo et al., 2025a]通过强化学习,以可核查的奖励来发展推理. 绝对零[赵等人,2025年]生成并解决可执行的任务,使用代码执行器验证这些任务,而SEAL[Zweiger等人,2025年]则生成微调数据并更新指令,并评价由此产生的调整.
这些方法突出了核查在学习生成的材料方面的作用。 对于包含的轨迹,核查必须考虑到任务的完成和视觉结果与行动的一致性。

blocks.en:
DreamerV3 [ Hafner et al., 2025 ] learns a world model from environment interaction and improves its policy using imagined trajectories.
Robot policies can improve through deployment experience. RECAP [ Physical Intelligence et al., 2025a ] combines autonomous rollouts, reward feedback, and human corrections to train π 0.6 ∗ \pi^{*}_{0.6} , while SILVR [ Luo et al., 2026 ] uses execution experience to improve visual planning on unseen tasks.
WMPO [ Zhu et al., 2025 ] and RISE [ Yang et al., 2026a ] use learned world models to optimize policies through imagined interactions and reward or value feedback. Cosmos Policy [ Kim et al., 2026a ] refines future-state and value prediction using rollout experience to improve model-based planning.
Our framework uses a WAM’s own joint video-action predictions as supervision for iterative policy updates, without external action execution during adaptation.

DreamerV3 [Hafner et al., 2025] 从环境互动中学习一个世界模型,并利用想象中的轨迹改进其政策.
机器人政策可通过部署经验加以改进。 RECAP [物理情报等,2025a]结合了自主推出,奖励反馈,以及人矫正来训练π 0.6 *\pi^{*}_{0.6},而SILVR [Luo等,2026]使用执行经验来改进对隐形任务的视觉规划.
WMPO [Zhu等人,2025年]和RISE [Yang等人,2026年a] 利用学习过的世界模式,通过想象中的相互作用和奖励或价值反馈来优化政策. Cosmos Policy [Kim et al., 2026a] 利用推出经验完善未来状态和价值预测,以改进基于模型的规划.
我们的框架使用WAM自己的联合视频动作预测作为迭代政策更新的监督,在适应期间不执行外部动作.

blocks.en:
GigaWorld-1 [ GigaWorld Team et al., 2026 ] uses an action-conditioned world model for robot policy evaluation.
World Action Verifier [ Liu et al., 2026 ] uses forward-inverse disagreement to
select informative environment interactions for updating a world model.
Our verification instead selects visually successful, video-action-consistent
prefixes from the WAM’s own rollouts as training experience, without executing candidate actions in an external environment.
blocks.zh:
GigaWorld-1 [GigaWorld Team et al., 2026] 机器人政策评价采用行动有条件的世界模式.
世界行动核查人[刘等人,2026年]使用前向反向分歧
选择信息丰富的环境互动,以更新世界模式。
我们的核查选择了视觉上成功的 符合视频动作的
前缀来自WAM本身推出的培训经验,而不在外部环境中执行候选人行动。

blocks.en:
For VLAs, VLAct [ Yang et al., 2026b ] studies representation-centric continued
pretraining to improve transfer across tasks and embodiments.
UniPi [ Du et al., 2023 ] and RoboDreamer [ Zhou et al., 2024 ] generate video plans and recover actions through inverse dynamics. GR-1 [ Wu et al., 2024 ] jointly predicts images and actions after video pretraining, while Video Prediction Policy [ Hu et al., 2024 ] conditions an action decoder on predictive video features.
DreamGen [ Jang et al., 2025 ] trains policies on video-generated trajectories
with recovered pseudo-actions. Vid2WAM [ Qiu et al., 2026a ] distills an external
video teacher into a WAM using generated futures and IDM-inferred actions.
In our framework, the WAM generates both training targets, and the IDM checks their consistency.
LingBot-VA [ Li et al., 2026 ] and DreamZero [ Ye et al., 2026 ] jointly generate videos and actions, and Cosmos 3 [ NVIDIA, 2026 ] supports world-action generation within an omnimodal backbone.
Zero-WAM [ Zhou et al., 2026 ] studies unseen-task execution with human video guidance, whereas ReGen [ Govind et al., 2026 ] uses WAM-generated trajectories of previously learned tasks to mitigate forgetting during continual learning.
We instead generate and verify trajectories for tasks unseen during base-model training, then learn from them over successive rounds of self-improvement.

observation prompts, without the task instruction or desired outcome. It records
object identities, spatial relations, gripper contact, and visible changes in
object or robot structure. The judgment call then receives the same images,
the resulting description, the task instruction, and the active subgoal.
It checks goal satisfaction, required gripper release, object consistency,
and robot structural consistency. The program accepts an assessment only when
all four checks pass. A negative or uncertain check makes the assessment
non-accepting. Unsupported or conflicting facts in the description and its
image-grounded audit also prevent the affected check from passing.

blocks.en:
The IDM reconstructs actions from a video window, its starting robot state, and the task
instruction. We build it from Wan2.2 pretrained weights [ Team Wan et al., 2025 ] using a reduced-width Transformer
initialized by interpolating the pretrained tensors. We retain video conditioning and
action denoising, while removing the video denoising branch and its prediction loss. The
resulting model has approximately 0.9B trainable parameters. The Transformer has 30 layers,
a hidden width of 1,344, an FFN width of 5,376, and 24 attention heads. Video and
text encoders provide the conditioning features for action flow prediction.
